name: adr183-continuation-native-18
result: Native pass of the extended continuation with ADR-184 steps 1-4/6, ADR-185 steps 1-4 and ADR-186, using only product commands, the actual applier and operator prerequisites: provider-installed workload guard with eight probes (five owner-account public-source probes, bridge proves three); worker roles, inputs and launch; ADR-185 public sources (browser and identity settings, empty cluster catalog with its guard); all 66 public runtime roles provisioned under operation-scoped proofs and the public runtime projection verified and published in one role operation; six owner identity roles (with routing and native-read), owner selection, provider artifact and applier, projection and launch. Both the worker and the owner run on the compiled image; the owner passes its provider proof and priming. Subtest 435.8 s inside the original 30-minute window.
scope: Real kind API, OpenBao, SeaweedFS S3 and PostgreSQL; synthetic public settings. The launched owner is observation-only (no Native/Public input yet, ADR-184 steps 5/7/8). No public workflow, rerun-after-bridge or helm upgrade replay claim.
